full_judgment: 3. The plaintiff's case, in brief, is that the suit property originally belonged to the plaintiff’s predecessors and the same was purchased by defendant's predecessor Gopal Chandra Mukherjee. The plaintiff's father was the bargadar under the defendants, who took settlement of the suit land from the defendants at a rental of Taka 5 on payment of cash salami of Taka 500 in karofa right. There was a good relation between the predecessors of plaintiff and defendants and plaintiff's elder brother Intaj Khan was the peon of the defendants' estate, so the settlement was created on the basis of dakhila. Subsequently, the plaintiff came to know that the suit land was wrongly recorded in SA Khatian in the names of defendant Nos. 1-3 and predecessor of defendant Nos. 4-6, which cast a cloud upon his title. Hence, the suit.
